intent: Looping run cycle with alternating knee drive and leg recovery, with reciprocal arm swing synchronized to the running rhythm.

phases.name: left-knee-drive
phases.description: Left knee drive builds while the right leg extends downward.

phases.name: left-leg-lowering-and-exchange
phases.description: The left leg begins lowering while the right leg advances through the exchange state.

phases.name: right-knee-drive
phases.description: Right knee drive builds while the left leg extends downward.

phases.name: right-leg-lowering-and-loop-return
phases.description: The right leg lowers while the left leg recovers toward the loop seam.

keyPoses.description: Left knee high, with the right leg extended downward.
Right knee high, with the left leg extended downward.
Leg-exchange state returning near the loop seam.

weightTransfer.description: The pelvis shifts laterally toward +X from around f4 to f13, then returns near its initial X position by f19, while the lower extended leg alternates from the right side to the left side.
weightTransfer.contactCaveat: Exact foot-contact frames are not asserted because animation.json has no explicit foot-contact channel; this interpretation relies on pelvis motion and visible leg configuration.

bodyMechanics.description: Between the two knee-drive extremes, upper-body twist reverses and the arm-swing state switches sides correspondingly. f8 is the intermediate exchange state.

recommended: timing of a looping run cycle
upper-body and arm coordination between stride extremes
